name: Shinonome Mari
source:
She's studying earnestly to be a veterinarian at a university because she has loved animals since she was a child. 

As she's a diligent and hardworking girl, she's trusted by her juniors, seniors, and professors alike, and is held in high regard by them.

In reality, she's a little shy around people, and thinks that being with animals is much more comfortable. Because of that, she volunteers a lot to look after the pets and animal patients, which then raises her colleagues appreciation of her even more. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.cyc-soft.com/cyclet/cyclet_main.html]Official Site[/url]]
